lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: python-langchain-hardcoded-allow-dangerous-code-true
title: LangChain agent created with hardcoded allow_dangerous_code=True (RCE via LLM-generated Python)
summary: 'The CSV/pandas/Python agent is created with `allow_dangerous_code` hardcoded to True. This lets
  the LLM

  execute arbitrary Python on the server, and prompt injection or untrusted CSV content can turn that
  into

  remote code execution. The dangerous capability must be off by default and enabled only through an

  explicit, user-controlled opt-in setting.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-94
- CWE-95
severity: critical
confidence: high
languages:
- python
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: d8c6480daa17b2f2af0b5470cdf5c3d28dc9e508
  vulnerable_ref: d8c6480daa17b2f2af0b5470cdf5c3d28dc9e508^
  patched_ref: d8c6480daa17b2f2af0b5470cdf5c3d28dc9e508
  repository: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow
rule:
  message: '`allow_dangerous_code` is hardcoded to True, so the agent can execute arbitrary Python generated
    by the

    LLM (RCE through prompt injection or malicious data). Default it to False and expose an explicit opt-in.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern-either:
    - pattern: '{..., "allow_dangerous_code": True, ...}

        '
    - pattern: 'dict(..., allow_dangerous_code=True, ...)

        '
    - pattern: '$FUNC(..., allow_dangerous_code=True, ...)

        '
    - pattern: '$D["allow_dangerous_code"] = True

        '
fix:
  guidance: 'Do not hardcode allow_dangerous_code=True. Add an advanced BoolInput (default False) with
    a clear

    security warning and read it with getattr(self, "allow_dangerous_code", False) or False, passing that

    value to the agent factory so the dangerous behaviour is secure by default.

    '
  example: "BoolInput(\n    name=\"allow_dangerous_code\",\n    display_name=\"Allow Dangerous Code\"\
    ,\n    value=False,\n    advanced=True,\n    info=\"SECURITY WARNING: allows arbitrary Python execution\
    \ on the server.\",\n)\n\nallow_dangerous = getattr(self, \"allow_dangerous_code\", False) or False\n\
    agent_kwargs = {\n    \"verbose\": self.verbose,\n    \"allow_dangerous_code\": allow_dangerous,\n\
    }\n"
